title: Software Development Engineer (SDE-1 / Fresher)
experience_level: Fresher / 0-1 Years (B.Tech / B.E. in CS / IT / ECE)
job_description:
We are seeking a high-potential Software Development Engineer (SDE-1) to join our core backend engineering team. As an entry-level engineer, you will write scalable, clean code, participate in code reviews, design efficient database schemas, and build microservices powering millions of requests daily.

Key Responsibilities:
- Design, develop, and maintain high-performance RESTful APIs and backend microservices.
- Apply strong Data Structures and Algorithms (DSA) to solve complex computational problems.
- Work with relational databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL) and caching layers (Redis) to optimize database queries.
- Write modular, testable, and maintainable code adhering to SOLID principles and OOP design patterns.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams in an Agile / Scrum development environment.
- Participate in CI/CD pipeline deployments using Docker and GitHub Actions.

Minimum Qualifications:
- B.Tech / B.E. / MCA in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related quantitative field.
- Strong proficiency in at least one core language: Java, C++, Python, or Go.
- Sound understanding of Computer Science fundamentals: Operating Systems, Computer Networks, and DBMS.
- Hands-on experience with Git version control, REST APIs, and SQL.
min_education: B.Tech / B.E. / MCA in Computer Science or related branch
